votes.description: The Board approved the meeting minutes from the November 10, 2022 RDA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 01 of 2023 amending the Bylaws to shorten the Chairperson's Term to One Year
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the RDA bylaws to reduce the Chairperson's term from two years to one year.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 02 of 2023 approving the Interlocal Agreement for the State Street CRA between Salt Lake County and the Salt Lake City Redevelopment Agency
votes.description: The Board approved an interlocal agreement with Salt Lake County allowing use of a portion of the County's property tax increment to support implementation of the State Street Community Reinvestment Area Plan.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 03 of 2023 approving the Housing Development Loan Funding Allocations for Affordable Housing, with the additional $2.36 million added
votes.description: The Board approved affordable housing funding allocations through the RDA's 2022 Notice of Funding Availability process, awarding up to $8.36 million in Housing Development Loan Program funds to incentivize development and preservation of affordable housing.

votes.motion: Substitute motion to use the $2.36 million in project 10, with the claw-back provision that if the credits are not received they are moved to projects 4, 5, and part of project 9
votes.description: A substitute motion was proposed to direct the additional $2.36 million to project 10 with a claw-back provision requiring the funds to be redirected to projects 4, 5, and part of project 9 if tax credits were not received; the motion failed on a tie vote.
